title: MANİFEST - TOZPEMBE Dansını Öğrettim! 💖 Yeni Koreografiyi Birlikte Öğreniyoruz!

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains K-pop choreography step-by-step with clear counting and directional breakdown. She alternates between talking to the camera and demonstrating the steps from the front.

lesson_structure.note: Greets viewers and introduces the Tozpembe dance tutorial
Breaks down the first counts and arm movements
Detailed close-up breakdown of arm and shoulder movements
Practices the sequence slowly with counting
Breaks down the next set of footwork and hip movements

common_mistakes: Not placing weight on the correct foot before jumping
Arm placement differing from the original choreography

steps_taught.name: Tozpembe opening step
steps_taught.description: Lifting and stepping with arm extension and punch

what_works: Breaking down arm and footwork separately
what_hinders: Fast transitions between speaking and dancing

quotes.text: Özellikle hileli koreografisine göre olmuş bence.
Hilal'in yaptığı bana göre çok daha estetik geliyor.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor steps right, raises arm, and punches on count 4
Weight shifts to the right foot while lifting the left leg and curving the arm overhead

extraction.distinctive_method: Compares her own stylistic interpretation with the original music video choreography to help learners choose their preferred version.
